thread.title: All 30 Dow industrials stocks and the 20 Dow transport stocks are falling - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow industrials stocks and the 20 Dow transport stocks are falling - MarketWatch
text: As the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.14% tumbles 659 points, or 2.6%, in afternoon trade, all 30 of its components are losing ground. Of the biggest decliners, shares of Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -3.96% dropped 4.4%, Caterpillar Inc. CAT, -3.53% shed 4.3% and Intel Corp. INTC, -3.76% declined 4.3%. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc. AAPL, -3.31% which shed 3.5% toward the lowest close since April 30. Elsewhere, the Dow Jones Transportation Average DJT, -3.78% lost 4.2%, with all 20 components falling. Meanwhile, the defensive Dow Jones Utility Average DJU, +0.62% rose 0.5%, with 14 of 15 components gaining ground.
